name: Depth Estimate
description: Gives a picture as a depth picture: gray, 3 channels, the nearest part white and the farthest black (stretched to the full range), at the size of the picture. Use it as a reference for an Edit workflow, or to see the shape of a scene. Depth Anything V2 through ONNX Runtime.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A Depth Anything V2 ONNX file. The picker offers the download of the Small model, with its licence shown first.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.description: The size the shorter side of the picture is looked at (rounded to a multiple of 14). Higher shows finer detail and takes longer; the result is always the size of the picture.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Auto uses the GPU when the pack's environment has the CUDA build of ONNX Runtime.
